Class PriceStreamBroadcaster

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.marketdata.stream.PriceStreamBroadcaster
@Component public class PriceStreamBroadcaster extends Object
Broadcasts live simulation ticks to subscribed clients over Server-Sent Events, optionally filtered to a subset of symbols per subscriber.

Ticks arrive on the simulation's tick thread, and nothing here may block it: an SSE write blocks for as long as the client isn't reading (a stalled tab, a dropped connection the proxy hasn't noticed yet - up to the socket's write timeout), and writing inline froze the whole market for every instrument and every other subscriber while it waited. So each subscriber gets its own sender on a virtual thread, and the tick thread only hands it the price. What a subscriber hasn't been sent yet is conflated to the latest price per symbol, which is all a live view needs and bounds a slow client's backlog to one entry per symbol it watches.
